research.question: Does the fixed confirmation-first BTCUSDT five-minute candle interpretation have positive mean net R on untouched 2025 data?
research.hypothesis: Mean net R after fixed modeled costs and funding is positive.

project_choices.decision: Strict 20/50 close EMA two-period confirmed fractal; fixed 1.5R target, stop at confirmation EMA50, one position; modeled fees 5bp and slippage 2bp each side.
2025-01-01 through 2026-01-01 UTC; reserve the preceding 500 warm-up bars until after freeze.

uncertainties.statement: Five 73-day batches are validated on defined synthetic models but assume stable weakly dependent finite-variance influence observations; long memory and regime breaks may invalidate nominal coverage.
Recorded funding times and 5m candle paths do not establish actual funding eligibility or precise fills; simulation uses explicit conservative conventions.
Noncommercial Binance Vision use is operator-authorized; assess attribution, CC BY-NC-SA treatment and REST terms for eventual publication.

inputs: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT 5m holdout archives and checksums
Public funding history with associated marks
method.population: 365 UTC days of 2025 Binance BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual 5m candles.
method.eligibility: Exactly 500 preceding warmup bars and 105120 contiguous 5m evaluation bars with valid UTC timestamps and OHLCV; complete funding rate and mark each 8h settlement, publisher checksum, identity, valid risk and supported contract semantics. >=200 trades and >=30 days with trades, >=1 per 73-day batch, no open position.
method.time_boundary: Development [2024-01-01T00:00:00Z,2024-12-30T00:00:00Z), warmup begins 2023-12-30T06:20:00Z. Reserved historical holdout warmup [2024-12-30T06:20:00Z,2025-01-01T00:00:00Z); evaluation [2025-01-01T00:00:00Z,2026-01-01T00:00:00Z). No pivot outside evaluation. Open trade at end means INCOMPLETE, no terminal liquidation.
method.transformations: 5m BTCUSDT USD-M bars, 500-bar warmup, EMA20/50 close seeded first warmup close alpha 2/(N+1); strict 2-left/2-right fractal, pivot extreme between EMAs and trend ordering valid at pivot and confirmation; signal at close t+2, next open t+3 proxy; stop fixed at confirmation EMA50, 1.5R target, one position. 5bp fees and adverse 2bp slippage per side; observed open first; adverse gap stop, target no price improvement, stop first when intrabar collision. Funding retains actual timestamp 0-1000ms after each 8h boundary, with conservative ambiguous intrabar exposure. 1BTC unit, exit-day R; no real execution or leverage claim. At an exact funding/open timestamp charge pre-existing exposure before open exits/entries; for later event charge new/open position, choose adverse funding if exit order is unknowable, and retain original timestamp. Funding requires one event per expected 8h boundary, offset 0-1000ms, finite rate and positive mark. Net R=(direction*(slipped exit-slipped entry)-entry fee-exit fee-signed funding)/initial slipped-entry-to-stop risk. Trades assigned to exit UTC day.
method.acceptance_rule: For a valid, adequate run, MET iff lower bound of two-sided 95% interval >0; upper bound <0 gives negative-expectancy evidence, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Positive cumulative return alone is insufficient. 365 UTC days, >=200 completed trades, >=30 distinct exit days, >=1 trade per block, no open position; otherwise INCOMPLETE. Zero trades, insufficient trades/days/batches, or open position produce INCOMPLETE without a scientific verdict. Invalid data, missing funding, checksum/schema mismatch or nonfinite/nonpositive inference variance produce TECHNICAL_FAILURE where the platform can start; missing bound bytes can prevent run reservation.
method.inference_criterion: Pair daily sum of net R and completed count by UTC exit day, including zero days. Partition 365 days into five consecutive 73-day blocks; theta=sum(S)/sum(N); Z_j=sum over block j of (S-theta*N); SE=sqrt((5/4)*sum(Z_j^2))/sum(N); two-sided CI theta +/- 2.7764451051977987*SE in binary64. Five blocks, no resampling. Nonfinite or nonpositive SE is TECHNICAL_FAILURE.

non_goals: Actual trading or verified exchange fills
